correctness.rationale: For n≥2, B,r,K,c,h>0, maximize Σf(x_i) with Σx=B and f(t)=rt−rt²/K−ct/(1+ht). f''(t)=−2r/K+2ch/(1+ht)^3 is strictly convex (its second derivative positive). If a maximizer has 0<a<b, first stationarity under pair transfer gives ∫_a^b f''(t)dt=0; strict upper Hermite–Hadamard yields f''(a)+f''(b)>0, a forbidden positive second variation. Thus every positive entry equals B/k. G_k=kf(B/k) and G_k−G_{k+1}=B²/[k(k+1)]·[ch/((1+hB/k)(1+hB/(k+1)))−r/K]; zeros c_k=r/(Kh)(1+hB/k)(1+hB/(k+1)) strictly decrease with k. Strict signs on either side show only k wins for c_k<c<c_{k−1}, with exactly k,k+1 tied at c_k, no skipped support or unequal maxima. Verified Step3 and all boundaries from actual RESULT.md; independent exact rational threshold and G_k calculations for n=2–5 and multiple pressures matched; finite checks do not substitute for Hermite–Hadamard proof.
